Message:
KVM: VMX: fix build without CONFIG_SMP

'apic' is not defined if !CONFIG_X86_64 && !CONFIG_X86_LOCAL_APIC.
Posted interrupt makes no sense without CONFIG_SMP, and
CONFIG_X86_LOCAL_APIC will be set with it.
